name: models_in_sequence_order
note: account.reconcile.model search in _order = 'sequence, id' (addons/account/models/account_reconcile_model.py): rule type, trigger, matching order, active flag and company of every model as the bank reconciliation widget lists them; all rows (active_test off)
source_sql: SELECT id, sequence, rule_type, trigger, matching_order, active, company_id FROM account_reconcile_model ORDER BY sequence, id

name: lines_and_partners_per_model
note: account.reconcile.model.line_ids one2many (embedded as accountReconcileModel.line) and match_partner_ids many2many (embedded as resPartnerRel): write-off lines, their lowest account and matched partners per model; models without lines or partners included with 0
source_sql: SELECT m.id AS model_id, (SELECT count(*) FROM account_reconcile_model_line l WHERE l.model_id = m.id) AS lines, (SELECT min(l.account_id) FROM account_reconcile_model_line l WHERE l.model_id = m.id) AS first_account, (SELECT count(*) FROM account_reconcile_model_res_partner_rel r WHERE r.account_reconcile_model_id = m.id) AS partners FROM account_reconcile_model m ORDER BY m.id
